note: face, eyes and mouth render today as tags; body applies only at wear 0, because above that the garment damage state owns posture and two posture claims fight; voice_style and voice_rate do nothing unless the TTS engine accepts an emotion vector. Control is gone, which is the whole point of separating it from angry. Angry is narrowed glaring eyes with gritted teeth and a held, tense body; rage is a red face, WIDE eyes, a mouth open in a shout and a body already lunging.
face: red face, veins on forehead, bared teeth, shouting
eyes: wide-eyed, constricted pupils, glaring, bloodshot eyes
mouth: wide open mouth, shouting, bared teeth
body: lunging forward, clenched hands, arms rigid, leaning forward
